title: XRPLF/rippled GitHub Issues Search
key_points: Searches for issues in the XRPLF/rippled repository related to MPTokenIssuance and a specific pull request number.
Returns metadata about each issue found, including title, URL, labels, comments, created_at, updated_at, and author.
limitations: Does not contain the full content of the issues or discussions related to them.
Only returns information about issues that match the specific search query used.
asserts: The source claims to provide a list of GitHub issues matching certain criteria.
scope: GitHub Issues in the XRPLF/rippled repository.
